title: Sample sidecar metadata
description: Draft v0.2 (#229, hat added by #249, snare by #272, rim by #296, bass by #320, laser by #416, perc by #475, fx by #482, atmos by #529). Written next to every generated WAV as <name>.json. Must be sufficient to re-render the identical file. schema_version 0.1 = kick sidecars as before (still valid, kick keeps 0.1); 0.2 is required for clap, hat, snare, rim, bass, laser, perc, fx and atmos sidecars and not allowed for kick. Engine identity is per category (D-025): kick sidecars carry engine.name 'abeltongod-audio-engine' and its version; clap sidecars carry engine.name 'abeltongod-audio-engine-clap' and the clap engine's own version; hat sidecars carry engine.name 'abeltongod-audio-engine-hat' the hat engine's own version; snare sidecars carry engine.name 'abeltongod-audio-engine-snare' and the snare engine's own version; rim sidecars carry engine.name 'abeltongod-audio-engine-rim' and the rim engine's own version; bass sidecars carry engine.name 'abeltongod-audio-engine-bass' and the bass engine's own version; laser sidecars carry engine.name 'abeltongod-audio-engine-laser' and the laser engine's own version; perc sidecars carry engine.name 'abeltongod-audio-engine-perc' and the perc engine's own version; fx sidecars carry engine.name 'abeltongod-audio-engine-fx' and the fx engine's own version, and their features also carry boundary_frame and anchor; atmos sidecars carry engine.name 'abeltongod-audio-engine-atmos' and the atmos engine's own version, and their features also carry loop_samples, loop_samples_exact, seamless and preroll_loops (atmos-params $comment points 1, 8, 15). A re-render compares only the name/version pair of its own category, so a byte change in one category never invalidates the sidecars of another (D-013 holds inside each category).

parameters.description: Exact <category>-params object used (kick-params for kick, clap-params for clap, hat-params for hat, snare-params for snare, rim-params for rim, bass-params for bass, laser-params for laser, perc-params for perc, fx-params for fx, atmos-params for atmos; fx and atmos record the fully resolved object including the per-kind defaults), including the variant's derived seed.

fundamental_hz.description: Pitched samples (kick; bass: the note frequency measured in the stationary window of the gate, null if that window is shorter than 2 periods, see bass-params). Optional; absent or null for non-pitched samples.

spectral_centroid_hz.description: v0.2, non-pitched samples (clap, later hat). Spectral centroid of the whole file, Hz.

hf_share_8k.description: v0.2. Share of the spectral energy above 8 kHz, 0 ... 1.

t60_ms.description: v0.2. Time from the peak until the envelope has fallen 60 dB, ms, measured on the signal after a 30 Hz high-pass; null if it does not within the file.

rise_time_ms.description: v0.2. Onset rise time, 10 % to 90 % of the peak envelope, ms.

boundary_frame.description: v0.2, fx only (required there, #482). Frame index of the musical boundary, round(length_beats * 60 * sample_rate / bpm) for every kind: the first frame at the bar line. Anchor start (a riser's drop): the first frame of the tail. Anchor end (reverse_crash, no tail): the frame count N, one past the last frame N - 1. A placer aligns this frame index with the event's bar line.

anchor.description: v0.2, fx only (required there, #482). start = the file's first sample sits on the event beat; end = the file ends on it (reverse_crash).

loop_samples.description: v0.2, atmos only (required there, #529). N = round(240 * bars * sample_rate / bpm) frames (atmos-params point 1): the whole file in seamless mode; in oneshot mode the frame index of the musical end (first frame of the tail).

loop_samples_exact.description: v0.2, atmos only (required there). 240 * bars * sample_rate / bpm before rounding; differs from loop_samples by at most 0.5 (the musical length is exact only when it is an integer).

seamless.description: v0.2, atmos only (required there). true = loop_mode seamless: the file is one period and loops without a seam; false = oneshot.

filter.description: Warm-up periods P of the moving filter (atmos-params point 8); 0 when filter_mode is off or in oneshot mode.

reverb.description: Warm-up periods P of the reverb; 0 when reverb_mix is 0 or in oneshot mode.

preroll_loops.description: v0.2, atmos only (required there). Warm-up periods per recursive stage that the engine ran before keeping the last period.

tuning_error_cents.description: v0.2, atmos only, optional. Bin-locked fundamental minus the requested note, cents (atmos-params point 11): drone and granular with a drone or metal source; null for the other kinds.

realised_detune_cents.description: v0.2, atmos only, optional. drone: interval of the detuned copy of the root's first partial (detune_bins bins higher), cents; null if detune_bins is 0 or the kind is not drone.
